name: VQA-RAD
intro: VQA-RAD是首个由临床医生手工构建的放射学视觉问答数据集，包含315张放射学图像和3515个临床医生自然提问，涵盖头部、胸部、腹部等多个解剖区域，旨在推动医学VQA技术发展。
eval_feature_en: The first radiology VQA dataset manually constructed by clinicians
intro_en: VQA-RAD is the first radiology visual question answering dataset manually constructed by clinicians, containing 315 radiology images and 3,515 natural questions from clinicians. It covers multiple anatomical regions including the head, chest, and abdomen, aiming to advance medical VQA technology.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A(Radiology Image Sources) --> B[Image Collection]
    B --> C[Image Selection & Anonymization]
    C --> D[Doctor-posed Q&A Generation]
    D --> E{Annotation Quality Check}
    E -- Pass --> F[Expert Review & Validation]
    E -- Fail --> G[Annotation Refinement]
    G --> D
    F --> H(VQA-RAD Dataset)
    H --> I[VQA Model Evaluation]
    I --> J(Improved Patient Care)
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Sample 315 balanced radiology images from MedPix teaching cases across head, chest, and abdomen"] --> B["Filter images for sharpness, unique patients, no markings, and expert-validated captions"]
    B["Filter images for sharpness, unique patients, no markings, and expert-validated captions"] --> C["Develop question taxonomy from TDIUC categories, MedPix reports, and CME question sources"]
    C["Develop question taxonomy from TDIUC categories, MedPix reports, and CME question sources"] --> D["Recruit 15 clinical trainees post-core rotations to generate free-form questions for 20 randomized images"]
    D["Recruit 15 clinical trainees post-core rotations to generate free-form questions for 20 randomized images"] --> E["Pair trainees to rephrase and frame others' questions using templates for another 20 images"]
    E["Pair trainees to rephrase and frame others' questions using templates for another 20 images"] --> F["Validate question-answer pairs via strict and loose agreement including inversion, conversion, and subsumption"]
    F["Validate question-answer pairs via strict and loose agreement including inversion, conversion, and subsumption"] --> G["Resolve 280 disagreements through team consensus meetings and expert radiologist ground truth review"]
    G["Resolve 280 disagreements through team consensus meetings and expert radiologist ground truth review"] --> H["Calculate F1 scores for evaluated pairs and finalize question type categorization"]
